display.purpose: Page titles. Project name, workspace name. The largest text on any surface.

body.purpose: Default text. Descriptions, paragraphs, help text.

label.purpose: Section kickers, metric labels, form field labels. Small, uppercase, assertive.

mono.purpose: Code blocks, JSON previews, blueprint drafts. Structured data display.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Cards at rest. Subtle baseline layering.

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: Hovered cards, dropdown menus. Slight lift.

shadows.name: shadow-xl
shadows.purpose: Critical overlays. Maximum elevation. Rarely used.

motion.name: transition-base
motion.purpose: Standard state transitions: hover, focus, expand.

motion.name: transition-slow
motion.purpose: Larger movements: panel reveals, disclosure toggles.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action button. Navy fill, white text, 10px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 34px; border: 1px solid #00204A; border-radius: 10px; background: #00204A; color: #ffffff; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; padding: 7px 11px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #001528; border-color: #001528; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(0, 32, 74, 0.72); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting action button. White fill, navy text, strong border.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-secondary"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/><polyline points="7 10 12 15 17 10"/><line x1="12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="3"/></svg> Export</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 34px; border: 1px solid #b8c4d0; border-radius: 10px; background: #ffffff; color: #00204A; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; padding: 7px 11px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f4f6f9; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(0, 32, 74, 0.72); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary svg { flex: 0 0 auto; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Inline status communication. Pill-shaped, colored by severity.
components.css: .ds-badge { min-height: 24px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #dce3eb; padding: 3px 8px; color: #3d4f63; background: #f4f6f9; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 750; line-height: 1.2; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-success { color: #1aae39; border-color: #b5dfbf; background: #d9f3e1; } .ds-badge-danger { color: #e03131; border-color: #efb6c9; background: #fde0ec; } .ds-badge-warning { color: #dd5b00; border-color: #f0c0a0; background: #ffe8d4; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field. Border, white background, focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { min-width: 0; min-height: 34px; border: 1px solid #b8c4d0; border-radius: 10px; background: #ffffff; color: #00204A; padding: 8px 10px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; transition: border-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #00204A; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0, 32, 74, 0.08); outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #4b5c6f; }

components.name: Dimension Row
components.description: Clickable list item for dimension navigation. Grid layout with label, badge, and arrow.
components.css: .ds-dim-row { width: 100%; min-height: 54px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 18px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; color: #00204A; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #dce3eb; border-radius: 10px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-dim-row:hover { background: #f4f6f9; border-color: #b8c4d0; } .ds-dim-row span { display: grid; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; } .ds-dim-row b { font-size: 14px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-dim-row small { color: #4b5c6f; font-size: 12px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-dim-row svg { flex: 0 0 auto; color: #4b5c6f; }

components.name: Score Ring
components.description: Animated SVG ring gauge showing quality score 0-100. Color coded by threshold.
components.html: 80QUALITY
components.css: .ds-score-ring { width: 88px; height: 88px; position: relative; } .ds-score-ring svg { display: block; } .ds-score-label { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-score-value { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; } .ds-score-text { font-size: 9px; color: #4b5c6f; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin-top: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
A precision instrument for structured data work. The interface is clean, confident, and engineered. Every surface communicates clearly; nothing is decorative. The system earns trust through visual precision: aligned grids, consistent token usage, and predictable interaction patterns.

This is not a consumer app; it's a professional tool that respects the domain expertise of OneStream consultants and finance architects. The design is dense without being chaotic, modern without chasing trends, and quiet without being lifeless.
keyCharacteristics: Information density served by structured whitespace, not by cramming
Single-family typography (Montserrat) carrying all hierarchy through weight and scale
Restrained color strategy: navy + tinted neutrals, with brass-gold accent at less than 10%
Gently layered elevation conveying surface relationships without dramatic depth
Tactile, engineered components that feel precise and responsive

rules.name: The Restraint Rule
rules.body: Brass Gold appears on less than 10% of any given surface. Its rarity is the point. Primary actions are navy, not gold; gold is reserved for brand presence and selected emphasis.

rules.name: The Single Voice Rule
rules.body: One font family everywhere. No display/body pairing. Montserrat carries headings, buttons, labels, and body text. Hierarchy is weight and size, not family contrast.

rules.name: The Ambient Rule
rules.body: Shadows are ambient, never crisp. Black opacity never exceeds 10% in light mode. In dark mode, shadows deepen (20-35% opacity) but remain diffuse. No hard drop-shadows; no inset shadows for decoration.

dos: Do use the spacing token scale (4/8/16/24/32/48px) for all gaps and padding.
Do use gap for sibling spacing. Eliminate margin-collapse hacks.
Do use the single Montserrat family with weight contrast for all hierarchy.
Do use aria-live="polite" on all inline status messages that update asynchronously.
Do add title tooltips on metric labels to explain what each measurement represents.
Do use <details> for progressive disclosure of secondary tools.
Do persist user preferences (theme, disclosure state) in localStorage.
Do provide keyboard shortcuts for frequent actions.
donts: Don't use playful SaaS energy: no confetti, emoji-heavy UI, rounded bubbly cards.
Don't use legacy enterprise patterns: no gray-on-gray, tiny fonts, 2005 tab bars.
Don't waste space with ultra-minimal whitespace. Density matters.
Don't use neon accents, decorative gradients, or dark-mode-as-aesthetic.
Don't use Bootstrap defaults, Material cookie-cutter, or generic admin templates.
Don't use border-left/right > 1px as colored accent stripes.
Don't use glassmorphism or blur decoratively.
Don't use identical card grids (icon + heading + text repeated).
Don't use cursor: pointer on non-interactive elements.
Don't use transition: all. Specify exact properties.
Don't use hardcoded hex outside the token system.
Don't use em dashes in UI copy.
